fullName: Malta Private Guard Licence Exam (Award in Private Security Guard Services)
notes: Jobsplus's Award in Private Security Guard Services (MFHEA MQF Level 2, 4 ECTS, June 2025 course sheet): 40 hours in two modules of 20 hours, each ending with a 1-hour written assessment (Section A true or false, Section B multiple choice, Section C short answers), pass mark 45% per module. Providers approved by the Commissioner of Police (Cap. 389 art. 23) write their own papers, so no fixed count exists. Tigertest models the objective part as four 50-question mock tests, 26 Module 1 + 24 Module 2 per test, with 70% as Tigertest's readiness line. True or false items are written as four-option items; short answers are not modelled. Two content sets per module, sets first, then tests: 8 dashboard steps.
